notes.title: HypeTrain: Steam Next Fest + New Title Reveal!
notes.notes:
Heya! 

We're aware that no one likes to read long off-topic updates, so let's get straight to the point: two of our games will be participating in the upcoming Steam Next Fest, and we'd love it if you'd give their demos a chance. We can't promise a complete match to your tastes, but the quality is guaranteed.

The first one is Die in the Dungeon, a turn-based roguelike game where you don't use cards, but dice. Deal with enemies by combining powerful dice on your board, boost their effects with magical relics, and risk it all hoping for a good roll on unexpected encounters. Oh, and the protagonist here is a cute little frog - everyone loves frogs, right?

[img]https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2026820/extras/gameplay.gif[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2026820/Die_in_the_Dungeon

The second one is Intravenous 2, an old-school tactical stealth action game. Will you embrace the shadows or confront your foes head-on? The choice is yours. Save lives. Uncover secrets. Take vengeance. If you're up for some hardcore challenge - don't miss it, you'll dig it for sure.

[img]https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2608270/extras/Stealth_Approach_-_I2.gif[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2608270/Intravenous_2/

This post should have ended here, as there is no third game for the Fest. BUT there is a third, freshly revealed game that we would still like to present to you, so here we go: 

Canyons is a third-person extraction shooter set in a procedurally generated post-apocalyptic world where survival is only possible in the canyons. Play solo or gather a team of up to four players. Arm yourselves to the teeth, grab supplies, and set out to conquer the canyons on massive Crawlers. This one won't have a demo anytime soon, but if it's up your alley, be sure to wishlist the game so you don't miss out on it.

[img]https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2708860/extras/ezgif-4-f6818604f3.gif[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2708860/Canyons

Cheers, and we wish you as many exciting games as possible!

notes.title: Play New Demos by HypeTrain Digital – Steam Game Festival
notes.notes:
Hi!

We’re delighted to take part in the Steam Game Festival (June 16 - June 22), which is already live now! Throughout the event we've brought demos for each of the 8 games we are currently working on. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26684285/7abeae814099c7e99930eac874f252bae2418cb1.jpg[/img]

All of them are in different genres, settings and styles. You will surely find something that piques your interest! All the content available for Steam Summer Festival is free, some demos are long, some allow infinite play. Here is a little sneak peek of every title available.

[h1]Voidtrain[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26684285/24e19a0b140c0b6ba83248df68f6e3487ea01ea7.jpg[/img]

Voidtrain is a first-person action/survival game where you become a crew member of an interdimensional express. Build your own train, upgrade it, craft weapons and travel across different mysterious worlds full of outlandish creatures, Nazis and other dangers. 

https://youtu.be/o0bIODWSX5Y

Voidtrain’s demo features a base loop of the game, where you’ll be able to travel between biomes on your train, gather resources to upgrade it and stop by interdimensional train depots filled with Nazis ought to be defeated.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1159690/Voidtrain/

[h1]Tunche[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26684285/808ffccf6882a1b363b56fb5974520d31e81bbbe.jpg[/img]

Tunche is a charming, hand-drawn beat'em up hack and slash game with roguelike elements, co-op and a pinch of shaman witchcraft. Visit the amazonian jungle alone or together with your friends, choose one of the 5 unique characters and hack through hordes of enemies!

And if you like A Hat in Time, we got a big surprise for you — Hat Kid will be the 5th Playable Character in the game. Moreover, you’ll be able to test her in the demo! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/887450/Tunche/

[h1]Linked Mask[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26684285/836f39a47efe14ee46476b2b34cd0b1589117e91.jpg[/img]

Do you miss the golden era of Game Boy? Linked Mask is a 2D platformer that will make you reminiscent of the good old days, where a player has to overcome six towers, collect six masks containing elemental powers and ultimately conquer the Castle of the Primals. And there’s a chillingly cool soundtrack that will make your head bop as you traverse the deadly Towers!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1111590/Linked_Mask/

[h1]Jack Move[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26684285/f8610a50c9a9492fa4b446b492de33263cedb4ad.gif[/img]

Plunge into a VHS-era cyberpunk world of Jack Move, an RPG featuring japanese style turn based battles and gorgeous Hi-Bit pixel art. Take on the role of Noa, a vigilante hacker who is thrust into a world of murder, kidnapping and dark research after her father goes missing.  

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0yOLVvhsJFw

There’s a brand new demo of Jack Move available that features a new slums area, a new dungeon and a whole bunch of new enemies for you to tangle with. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1099640/Jack_Move/

[h1]Black Book[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26684285/acc2d0ccff5b5a3512dca0a38d0825549dedb276.gif[/img]

Black Book is a dark RPG Adventure based on Slavic mythology and featuring card-based combat. You will take on the role of Vasilisa, a young sorceress on a quest to revive her beloved one. In order to do so, she has to uncover all the 7 seals of Black Book — a demonic artefact, said to be powerful enough to grant any wish. 

The demo features an essential part of the story — the First Day of Vasilisa becoming a witch. You’ll be able to test test the core game mechanics, battle regular demons and even test your strength in a fight against a boss.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1138660/Black_Book/

[h1]There Is No Light[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26684285/9543af773b7ab1760c993449121e62b139a6e6c0.jpg[/img]

There Is No Light is a pixel-art action adventure in a dark post-apocalyptic setting, which tells a story of a protagonist fighting against a fallen underground civilization and its appalling religious rituals. 

In this demo you’ll be able to explore a small part of the game world. Visit a village, the existence of which remained unknown for a long time. Find out how people live in the underground world ruled by the Church of the Great Hand. Find your own playstyle by combining 3 available weapon types, so that eventually you can fight a giant boss Behemoth that gets in your way to freedom.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1132980/There_Is_No_Light/

[h1]Tower Princess[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26684285/403d20cb011202cd3f6da5a5f5c44bfa5e63aca8.jpg[/img]

Tower Princess is a 3D roguelike action platformer where you'll have to beat a dungeon, defeat a dragon, rescue a princess/prince and manage a perfect date with them! There’s a wide variety of royalty members you can hit on — you’ll be able to find someone you like even if you’re not into humans. 

The demo is a linear and brief sample of a run in one of the Castle's areas. It shows the visuals and the core gameplay of Tower Princess, but it's focused on the princess aid in combat, as without her help, you wouldn't stand a chance against the Evil Dragon. Are you ready to test yourself as a knight in shining armour?

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1138650/Tower_Princess/

[h1]SuchArt![/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26684285/58eec9f3b1771872af7c94beb1b8d603f48ce8ec.gif[/img]

SuchArt is a painting sim game featuring you being such an amazing artist. Really you rock, your latest DNA test is very positive about it. Now please paint, sell and expose your art from your new studio aboard the Space City. And don’t forget — the only limit is the size of your brush (or a flamethrower).

SuchArt demo features a separate room (a virtual studio instead of a real one you’ll get in the full game) with a limited amount of tools and an introductory part of the story. However, you’ll be able to test the core game mechanics and take a couple of commissions from virtual clients, which is already fun!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1293180/SuchArt/

notes.title: Stoneshard Is Out In Early Access!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26684285/a8955c009635faad925bcafa3ff789b8d19721a6.png[/img]

Greetings fellow mercenaries!

Ink Stain Games and HypeTrain Digital are thrilled to announce that you’re invited to the relic hunt in the world of “Stoneshard” - a challenging turn-based RPG set in an open world with procedurally generated dungeons.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xwPAr4V3oK0

Stoneshard is a blend of a traditional turn-based RPG combat with brutal roguelike challenge, featuring an unrestricted character development and a complex injury treatment system.

Players who are well-acquainted with the traditional roguelike games will certainly find similarities between a classic dungeon crawler and Stoneshard - however, our game puts a larger emphasis on strategy and resource management. The game is set in a world rich with lore, which helps players immerse themselves in this setting while they explore the dangerous lands of Stoneshard.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/j04PE5qb3scVxZe0EE/giphy.gif[/img]

Explore the open world of Aldor, a kingdom in ruin where danger lurks around every corner...

notes.title: The Wild Eight 1.0.6 - Crashes fixed, Changes to Online System!

Good news everyone! 
The issues that resulted in crashes during solo play are fixed with this update! We're continuing our work on improving and bettering the game - and hoping you'll enjoy it more and more with every patch! 

[b]Another important note: 
[/b]Due to a lot of negative feedback surrounding the game's Matchmaking system, we've decided to include the following changes with this update- "Find Servers" option is now disabled. 
A lot of players reported multiple network-related issues that occured only while joining a game through "Find Servers" option. 
For now, you'll be able to join your friends in-game through Steam Invite, or "Friend Servers" menu in-game.

[*] Fixed an issue in which players sometimes were kicked out to the main menu while playing solo

notes.notes:
[b]Greetings, Survivors!
[/b]
An unnamed whistleblower recently provided us with several documents, leaked directly from VAPOR-3 servers. Among these files, some were particularly intriguing… 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26293681/2b4a5f3abad877d479075ee98c9aac8af84fc4cc.png[/img]
[i]
Report File #001 

Coordinates: 64.2005° N, 149.4937° W

Object: U.S. Navy Submarine SSN-792 “Vermont” 

Point Of Origin: 8.7832° S, 124.5085° W[/i]


[b]Report: 

The “Vermont” was found during area survey by researchers ████████████████ and ████████████████████████████████ . This report is a transcription of their spoken word re-telling of the encounter with the “Vermont”.

“We were patrolling through the woods - looking for the any evidence of Dark Matter , which began showing up more and more after the ████████████████ . 

We initially thought that it was another part of the Kennicott Mining Facility, since the mines were scattered all over the area after the ████████ ████████ event.

However,  upon closer inspection it turned out to be the hull of a submarine. How did it get there? It almost looks like it was just transported from somewhere - and just stuck into the middle of the land. Like a teleporter accident, where a guy gets stuck in the wall - like in one of those sci-fi movies, you know?...

We circled it a bunch of times before we found any markings on the hull - and after we found out the ship’s name, we immediately reported it to Mann.   After a few minutes, word came back from the ████████ facility that there was a submarine that went by that name and number. In fact - there was a SSN-792 “Vermont” out in the Atlantic Ocean at the time, with its crew completely intact. 

Soon as we heard it, a deafening thud shook both me and ████████   - and it sounded like multiple people, banging against the hull. Were those people, in fact, people or not - I don’t know. 
We ran off as fast as we could… 
Whoever could help the crew - it wasn’t gonna be us.”
[/b]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26293681/3d7afb04ec8bc60cd6be37237dd937e1b45a81b9.png[/img]

[i]Report File #002

 Coordinates: 64.2013° N, 149.832° W

Object: Kennicott Mining Camp 

Point Of Origin: Kennicott, Alaska [/i]

[b]Report: 


This bears many similarities to the “Vermont” Case: 

[list]
[*] This structure, originally found in the center of Kennicott, Alaska , has appeared in the vicinity of VAPOR-3 ████████ Facility
[*] The structure appears to be a ██████  copy of the actual place - as the original in Kennicott is still intact. 
[*] The structure has undertaken heavy internal damage, with many of its interior destroyed. 
[*] Heavy Dark Matter readings near both structures.
[/list]

However, what is different this time is this - the “Vermont” had the entire crew inside. 
The building itself is completely empty. In fact, not a single trace of human remains were found in the building. 

Some of our researchers reported sounds of footsteps and howling-like sounds - but no evidence supporting any kind of creature being inside the facility was found.

Will continue to investigate. 
[/b]


====


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26293681/7edf35dae95bb407201750f9cbd8b033052908a3.png[/img]

[i]Report File #003  

 Coordinates: 64.2013° N, 149.832° W

Object: ████████████████ Dimension Portal  

Point Of Origin: ████████[/i]

[b]Report: 


This picture, along with the polaroid camera it was taken with, was found on ██████ grounds - along with other seemingly random items, scattered around the area.  Some of the items closely resemble the ones pictured in the photo - especially the object itself, broken into pieces all around the area. 

Near the camera was an Anchorage Aces hoodie, a pair of ███████ jeans and ███ shoes. Presumably, these items belonged to the owner of the camera - however, there was no trace of the owner himself. More than that, there were no footprints, or any markings that could’ve indicated a person being anywhere near the area. 

The VAPOR-3 ████████ Researcher’s current theory is that the owner experienced ███████████ vortex - however, how did he, along with ████████, got there is currently unknown. Some speculate that he went hrough to the █████ portal - and that the reason these have been appearing more directly coincides with ████████ increased activity near the Dark Matter core. 

Of course, all of this still remains nothing more than speculation. [/b]

notes.title: 6 Days Left - Animals Of The Wild Eight
notes.notes:
[b]Hello, Survivors! 
[/b]
What is the Wild without any animals? Today we’ve got for you a mighty informative post about animals of The Wild Eight with the real-life facts about them!


[h1]Sitka Black-tailed Deer[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26293681/4c1d7ff2f158b157beab67ffcd0efb8b0fd5cc30.png[/img]

The Sitka Black-tailed Deers are native to the Alaskan wilds. Over the years their range of habitat expanded and now they can be found in the land’s many coastal forests. However, due to their diet, their population heavily depends on the severity of winters.

Since in The Wild Eight the spring might never come, in-game deers can be considered endangered species! Their only sustainable in-game source of food are those northern berries and mushrooms — which are constantly getting plucked by the players. Maybe that’s why it’s so much easier to tame them in The Wild Eight than in real life? So don’t forget to feed your pet deer well — you might be its last hope for survival!

[h1]Interior Alaskan Wolf[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26293681/1912c0446a31e6b406e10200880e6435ace6f8c4.png[/img]

Despite its name, the Interior Alaskan Wolf is not even close to becoming domesticated and is instead called like this for inhabiting the interior part of the Alaskan wilds. They differ from their North American counterparts by a longer skull with bigger and heavier teeth in both jaws. Alaskan wolves have a very bloody history — they were hunted extensively even before Alaska became a part of USA. They mostly rely on migrating caribou as a source of food. And this led people to believe that sudden drop in numbers for caribou herds was caused by wolf overpopulation. 

While this is turned out to be mostly untrue in case of the real-life Alaskan wolves, in The Wild Eight they pose an immense threat! Especially for the players in the early stages of the game.  However, there is very little food for them around, so they might be just incredibly hungry and not necessary bloodthirsty. Tame a wolf and treat it well — and you’ve got yourself the most loyal and powerful ally!

[h1]Brown Bears[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26293681/68433929be4dd1dce757b421d4868eda2a0bfad9.png[/img]

There are multiple subspecies of brown bears scattered across Alaska and its archipelagos. Dall Island brown bear which has a broader skull and almost black fur. The infamous grizzly bear with its slightly concave face, a distinctive hump between shoulders and noticeably longer claws. Kodiak bear that’s inhabiting the Kodiak Archipelago for more than 10 000 years and can sometimes compete with polar bears in size. And the Sitka brown bears that look a lot like Alaskan grizzly, but inhabit only the Alexander Archipelago. 

Apart from varying appearance, everything else about the brown bears is mostly the same -- they’re omnivorous, go into hibernation for winter, and are very protective of their cubs. The biggest threat to brown bears is industrial logging. And we all know that some players in The Wild Eight mow down trees faster than any industry can. Be mindful of the bears!

[h1]Alaskan hare [/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26293681/c89a257a038dfafa0d33a82c21707dc133ca6ece.png[/img]

Also known as Tundra hare, has shorter ears compared to a normal hare and changes the colour of its fur through the year. It has brown fur with white underparts in the summer and fully white coat with dark ears in the winter. Tundra hare, unlike a common one, doesn’t nest in a burrow but instead hides between the rocks and bushes of the Alaskan tundra. 

In The Wild Eight Alaskan hares are heartless monsters. These little devils run away slow enough to look like a potential catch but are too fast to be actually caught by the player without any equipment. Teasing and exhausting the unfortunate survivors, hares lead to hundreds of deaths among the newer players [1].

[h1]Alaskan Red Fox[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26293681/bfc82cc9d36a501c4b6ce7934d04e938838bad62.png[/img]

Another species of a canine family famous for their dexterity. Red foxes are introduced species and were brought to Alaska to be farmed for their pelts in 20th century. Wild foxes are not the strongest animals, so they usually run away from anything that can pose a threat — including humans. Foxes are omnivores and easily adapt to any surroundings — so easy, in fact, that they can harm the ecosystem in some cases. 

In the case of The Wild Eight, nothing threatens foxes unless survivors are planning to hunt them for those sick fox-tail hats.


[h1]Boars or wild hogs[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26293681/b2e17c7e53bd608a0ced231f42edb08f28a5ec75.png[/img]

The population of wild hogs in Alaska is rather small and kept this way on purpose. These animals are considered highly invasive species that hurt the ecosystem on many levels. They uproot plant life, eat eggs of low nesting birds and even destroy crops in farmlands. Because of this, a hunting season for hogs is always open to prevent them from overbreeding. 

While in-game boars don’t cause any problems unless provoked, players at least can hunt them without having any regrets! Just make sure that you have an actual weapon equipped and not your pickaxe.

notes.title: 7 Days Left - Character Overview
notes.notes:
There's only a week left before The Wild Eight 1.0 comes out - and what a better time to get better acquainted with the survivors of Flight IRIS 816! Each one brings something new and different to the table - so there's something for everyone in The Wild Eight! 


[h1]William[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26293681/0b233d7ee2348ca4a1bee6705463ffd6c0b417ac.jpg[/img]

In the past, William worked as an oil worker in Alaska — so he’s already quite used to the harsh local weather. 

As someone who’s used to tough environments, he’s the most capable of the group.  

At first, he didn’t want to go back to Alaska — he was planning to settle down in Portland with his  wife and daughter, but the financial situation got too tough, so he was forced to go back to work.

After surviving the plane crash WIlliam immediately got himself together and quickly became the leader of the group. A man with a heart of gold and muscles of steel — he stands when others fall. 
 
[h1]Cole [/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26293681/07115a2597f22597af3fb5ff4eef7b033e804663.jpg[/img]

Cole lived in Portland and studied to become a history teacher — but soon after graduating he realized that it wasn't his calling. 

He decided to devote himself to MMA and after his successful debut he began to win fight after fight. A good right hook has become his favorite way of communicating. 

After seven victories in a row, Cole flew out to Anchorage to take part in his eighth fight. Cole is  a brash, hot-headed athlete on his way to fame — and he is the strongest one among the Wild Eight.

[h1]Vivian [/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26293681/198d8b82705386b8ed35a0495423e3ad55ac839a.jpg[/img]

Everyone always said that Vivian had “the Midas touch” — no matter what she did, it always ended up leading to some kind of benefit or profit! 

As lucky as she was, her brother Cooper  was the complete opposite — he always found himself in the worst possible situations, only to be saved by Vivian, again and again. 

When word got out that Cooper was once again in a bad spot, Vivian flew out to Anchorage to get him. This time Lady Luck played a nasty trick on Viv — she might have survived the plane crash, but whatever she faces next will show if luck’s really on her side.

[h1]Anna[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26293681/dbfda6bdcc453acf7b29e21ad52cfb68fdfcbdeb.jpg[/img]

Anna is an exemplary pharmacology student at the University of Anchorage. 

She went to Portland to visit her relatives over the holidays, but on the last day of her visit, a heavy snowfall started.

Anna quietly decided that she would spend the night at her parents' house and fly out tomorrow. That extra day would become the reason she happened to be on flight IRIS 816, which crashed in the middle of the Alaskan wilds. 

Anna is the youngest of the group, but thanks to her specialty she knows how to be valuable to the group — she gathers the medicinal herbs and plants and uses them to heal others.

[h1]Chang[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26293681/63bd2dc8baca1e0f963fb453eb66dcbc4edb4b57.jpg[/img]

Always smart and motivated, Cheng was naturally a quick learner — staying one step ahead of his peers in the curriculum. 

He chose "Improvement of Alaska's mineral exploration and extraction techniques" as the subject for his bachelor’s thesis. Soon he was contacted by Anchorage Science Centre, who offered Cheng a good position and a promising career. Eight days later Cheng was already getting on a plane. 


His smarts will be of great use in any situation - and even here, in the wilderness, he has no equal.

[h1]Jeffrey [/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26293681/d24e382dc870fd093c5a85794fba53dc27e9039a.jpg[/img]

Jeffrey is a brilliant engineer. He collects various devices and mechanisms, and he loves nothing more than spending time alone with them. 

The company he was working for was expanding — a new office was to open in Anchorage. Jeffrey immediately volunteered. 

After the crash, Jeffrey was dealing with nature, face to face. A perfectionist at heart, Jeffrey has always believed that whatever he did, everything had to be perfect. so crafting became something he excelled at. 

[h1]Oliver 
[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26293681/988e76bff19d37b951a742265672a75f345e1036.jpg[/img]
Oliver is a successful young entrepreneur, the owner of various well-known ventures.
 
He flew out to Anchorage to meet with potential investors, but the plane crash delayed the meeting indefinitely. 
Oliver doesn’t like to talk about his work now — he knows full well that in the wilderness, it doesn’t matter how much money you have. Only real skills will ensure your survival.

He adapted his exceptional problem solving skills to his new surroundings — proving that no matter the difficulty, any trouble can be eventually resolved.

[h1]Robin
[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26293681/4bae683b97b7879173929466d9eeb4c3104dd565.jpg[/img]

Robin is a young biathlete, winning championships eight years in a row. 

Together with another member of the national biathlon team, he flew to Anchorage to the training base. They were sitting next door, but when Robin came to his senses after the crash, he saw that his partner was already dead. 

Heartbroken and devastated, Robin quickly realized — if he doesn’t pull himself together, he’ll end up just like his partner. Thankfully, years of experience in biathlon have given Robin good marskmanship skills, and his athletic physique allows him to be the fastest and most agile in the group.

This update is going to wipe the save files of every user - this is due to our work on improving the netcode.. We apologize for this issue, and will do our best for this not to happen in the future. 

Now, onto the new things waiting for you in the update: 

[b]Lighting [/b]

The new and improved lighting makes the wintry Alaskan landscape look clear as a crisp spring morning. We hope that you’ll enjoy the way the game looks now! 

[b]Randomized Item Containers 
[/b]
Boxes and containers with randomized loot are now scattered all over the Alaskan forest - adding new flavor to an already familiar place! 


[b]Crafting re-structured 
[/b]
We’ve remade the recipes for some of the items in the Workshop, and added new crafting components - all designed to make crafting in The Wild Eight more streamlined and, most importantly, fun! Plus, you never know - some of these crafting components might be of use later…


[b]Improved Combat 
[/b]
From new attack options, to new visual effects - a lot of work was done on the combat in this update. You can now use any type of attack while moving, and each successful hit is now accompanied with a satisfying shaky-cam effect. 


[b]Creature AI improvements 
[/b]
Everything in The Wild Eight is constantly changing - and the numerous creatures that roam the wilds are no exception. The AI is now more refined and responsive, not to mention unpredictable! 


[b]General Improvements 
[/b]

A few Quality-Of-Life features have been added to the game, aimed at making our players’ experience a bit less challenging. You can now move the items from the Inventory to Workshop with Shift+Left Click; interactable items are now easier to recognize with a nifty outline, which also turns on when the player character is obscured from view - all of this alongside UI and optimization improvements.

notes.title: The Wild Eight: Shadow Hunt has arrived!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26293681/8e4b9104f1e22ca5478afdecc5721c36b619a4f5.jpg[/img]
Hello, survivors! The long polar night of no content updates is finally over! We’re thrilled to release a new major update for The Wild Eight called Shadow Hunt. The harsh lands of Alaska will present new challenges for the survivors with the introduction of the new boss and the food spoilage system!

[i]Main features include:
[/i]
[b]New quest[/b]: find the mysterious totems around the map and get the clues for lifting The Curse Of Wendigo. Face Wendigo, the dark manifestation of the ancient indian evil, himself. Explore the darkest corners of the abandoned museum or study the bizarre stonehenges. 

[b]Food spoilage system[/b]: gone are the times when you could always have a fresh snack in your pocket. All of your food items now have three conditions - Fresh, Spoiled and Rotten. The freshness is portrayed by a bar in the lower part of the item and its description. The freshness decays at a constant rate that can be slowed down by storing the food in the snow or in the Chest.

[b]New accessory and vanity items:[/b] pay homage to the indian heritage by wearing the Native American garb and fight the cold with the lighter which will help you lit campfires easier.

[b]UI Improvements:[/b] a fresh coat of paint for all of the main parts of the interface and player HUD. 

[b]And even more additions and fixes:[/b] improved visuals for the world and its creatures, animals re-balance, tweaks for melee combat and all weapons.

[i]Patch notes:
[/i]
[list]
[*] Added new quest ‘Shadow Hunt’. Find the mysterious totems and find a way to summon and defeat Wendigo!
[*] Introduction of the Food Spoilage system. Your food’s Freshness is portrayed by a bar in the lower part of the item icon - if it reaches the end, the food will become too rotten to eat!
[*] Several UI elements received a visual upgrade: Shelter UI, Workshop UI, Equipment UI, Quest Panel, Toolbar, Weapon Slots, Stat Bars.
[*] Adjustments to melee swing speed. Melee combat now has faster swings. 
[*] Weapon rebalance. Toned down overall power of melee weapons due to faster swings. Overall power of melee combat should remain roughly the same.
[*] Changed control scheme for ranged weapons. Guns and Bows now both control differently. With Guns you now hold RMB to aim and then press LMB to fire. Bows require aiming with RMB, holding down LMB to charge the shot and firing by releasing LMB.
[*] Added ‘Survey’ button to the Main Menu
[*] Rebalanced animals. All animals now move faster and the wolves have had their stats re-adjusted.
[*] Added new visuals for wolves
[*] Added camera shake for combat interactions
[*] Fixed an issue with Metro interface not opening or ceasing to respond when called from the panel on Mirror station.
[*] Fixed Isaac disappearing from the tile dedicated to Lost Future quest after player’s appearance 
[*] Fixed Isaac spawning in the wrong place or under the tile
[*] Fixed the items disappearing from the Workshop if its inventory hasn’t been changed after building in the case of its removal by Packing Up or due to the player's death
[*] Fixed an issue with the item drop button switching weapon slots
[*] Fixed left mouse button not looping attacking action when pressing and holding it right after another attack
[*] Fixed one of the cars giving 100 scrap in Shadows In The Night sidequest tile
[*] Fixed the tree in one of the tiles lying horizontally despite being available for harvesting
[*] Fixed Throwing Stones disappearing mid-air on The Bunker tile

We hope these changes will reinvigorate your surviving spirit and make the game more enjoyable! notes.title: The Wild Eight Beta is here!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26293681/cf5d1c110cda96c368796c855fd61f7c86c0a60e.png[/img]

We’re finally ready to introduce the new changes and fixes into the game! But not just yet -- if you own the game, we invite you to take part in playtesting the beta version of the update. Participate in beta, share your feedback and let’s make The Wild Eight better together!

[u][b]New Mechanic - Food Spoilage 
[/b][/u]
Get used to it - Food won’t last forever anymore!

...at least in the beta, for now.

All of your food items now have three conditions - Fresh, Spoiled and Rotten.
Your food’s Freshness is portrayed by the bar in the lower part of the item - if it reaches the end, the food will become too rotten to eat! 
The condition of your food is also shown in the item description and is indicated by the color of the bar - Green, Yellow, and Red respectively. 

The status of your food’s Freshness is portrayed by the bat in the lower part of the item - if it reaches the end, the food will become too rotten to eat! 

You can also slow down the spoilage by:

[list]
[*] Storing food items in the Chest
[*] Keeping food in the snow, which makes it Frozen - and lowers the spoilage rate. 
[*] Eating it as soon as you find it! 
[/list]


We’re still working hard making sure this feature is implemented properly - so make sure to leave your thoughts about this system! That way we’ll make it better in no time - especially if you fill out the Survey, conveniently placed right in the Open Beta’s Main Menu. 





[u][b]Animals
[/b][/u]
Following the updates to pathfinding, all animals now also have higher movement speed.
Also, the Wolves received a visual update and have new, rebalanced stats.

[u][b]Balancing
[/b][/u]
[b]Faster melee.[/b] Melee combat now has faster swings.
[b]Weapons rebalance. [/b]Toned down overall power of melee weapons due to faster swings. Overall power of melee combat should remain roughly the same, but it now feels more responsive.
[b]Ranged Weapon Control Change[/b] Guns and Bows now both control differently. With Guns, you now hold RMB to aim, and then press LMB to fire. Bows control similarly, except for one major element: you have to charge the arrow by holding LMB - and then release LMB to fire it. 
[b]Pistol rebalance.[/b] Pistol now has a more reasonable level of power.


[u][b]Visuals and UI
[/b][/u]
[b]New UI.[/b] While it’s still a work in progress, player HUD and all main windows got a new look.
[b]Camera shake.[/b] We are introducing the camera shaking effect for more visual feedback.
[b]World visual update. [/b]The in-game surroundings received some little tweaks to their visuals resulting in better image quality.


[u][b]How to participate in beta:
[/b][/u]
This beta testing will be available for all players who own the game. All you need to do is follow these steps:
[list]
[*] Click with your right mouse button on The Wild Eight in your Steam Library;
[*] Select Properties in the drop-down menu;
[*] In the opened window select BETAS tab;
[*] Choose from the drop-down list ‘thewildeightbeta’ and close the window;
[*] Wait until the game downloads the update and now you can play the beta!
[/list]

NOTE: Beta version of the game will contain its own save files. All progress made during beta does not carry onto the main game and will be wiped when the test period ends. Your save files from the main game will remain completely untouched.



Here's hoping you'll have fun with the Beta - and as always, please don't forget to leave any feedback, ideas or just thoughts about The Wild Eight in the official [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/526160/discussions/7/]Steam Discussion[/url] forums, or join our [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/S8WjNfU]Discord Channel[/url] to hang out with other fans! 

Thank you,
HypeTrain Digital

notes.title: New Content Update Announcement + Release Date Moved
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26293681/8e4b9104f1e22ca5478afdecc5721c36b619a4f5.jpg[/img]

How are you holding up, Survivors? 

We’ve got a lot of news for our players in this update - some good ones, and some not-so-good ones as well. 

Let’s start with the good news first! 

Introducing… 

[h1]The Wild Eight: Shadow Hunt
[/h1]
In the Shadow Hunt update, players will uncover the mysteries of an ancient Indian curse of the Wendigo, which for ages haunted the wilds of Alaska. Discover the mythical creature, and defeat him to rid the land of the curse!

[list]
[*] [b]New Quest The Wendigo[/b] – Search for clues on how to summon the mythical creature of the Alaskan wilds, and defeat him to lift the curse.
[*] [b]Combat re-balanced[/b] – visual and stylistic changes to the combat system, aimed to smooth out the gameplay experience. 
[*] [b]New Feature Food Rot[/b] – The Wild Eight just got more complex! The food you store in your inventory won’t stay there indefinitely - it will now slowly turn bad, becoming Spoiled and, over time, Rotten. Keep your food fresh by keeping it in the cold - or storing it in your Chest! 
[*] [b]UI additions[/b] – between some last-minute UI polish, How-To Play instructions and other small improvements here and there, we’re finalizing the overall look of the game’s interface.
[*] [b]Emotes [/b]– a new way to communicate with the other players around you, no chat required!
[*] M[b]ore side content[/b] – new locations, in-game creatures and wildlife re-balanced, and more! 
[/list]

[b]All of this awaits you in The Wild Eight: Shadow Hunt, coming to Steam on April 22. 
[/b]
....And that’s not all! 

All of our players will be able to test out the features included in the Shadow Hunt update before the official release of the update - and give their feedback directly to the development team, via Steam Discussions threads or our official Discord channel. 

We’ll carefully examine all of the reports from our player base, and will tweak and balance those features accordingly. 

We’ll reveal the dates, and features released for testing in the very near future - so check back here soon to become one of the participants! 

[h1]The Wild Eight 1.0 Release Date[/h1]
And now, unfortunately, it’s time for some bad news - The Wild Eight will not be able to make the previously-announced March 2019 release date as well as August 2019 for console ports. We apologize for misleading our audience. 

Some time ago, we faced a choice - either to make the deadline, and release an unpolished product, with some of the planned content either missing completely or not realized fully - or to finish what we started, and take a longer time doing it. 

For a long time we’ve been deep in the trenches, working hard on eliminating all of the bugs and issues that were caused by completely re-working the online infrastructure - a job that was needed to be done in order for our multiplayer to function properly. That increased the overall development cycle, but was ultimately worth it in the long run, allowing us to eliminate future issues with online - whether it’s on Steam, or consoles.

notes.title: 0.10 is Coming Tomorrow!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26293681/2e5f727a795e7e72c99e7f1a408d12e6216fea74.jpg[/img]

Greetings, Survivors! 

Finally, here we are - the long-awaited 0.10 update is just around the corner. 

This update focuses on some of the most requested features and improvements, so let’s dive a bit deeper into what 0.10 actually includes: 

[h1]Controller Support 
[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26293681/80fe4d32ebe25bf14112fd802e1a08df56b9d9cd.jpg[/img]

Finally, you’ll be able to play through all of The Wild Eight with your gamepad! Some even say that the game is more comfortable to play with a controller - why not give it a go? 

[h1]New Interface [/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26293681/eac8da7b9cc3be10d43ef720dc2ad9ca3cb606eb.jpg[/img]

To make sure the game is fully playable with a controller, we’ve given both the main menu and in-game HUD a major overhaul! It’s more practical than the previous version for multiple reasons - just as an example, the game now has a Mini-Map! The new style also gives the game a new, “fancy” feel, which we hope you’ll enjoy.

[h1]Changes To Game Session Structure 
[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26293681/8a6fdc51bc2f0755f9c6fbe29e7f3b3513280fa7.jpg[/img]

We’ve decided to give players more freedom in regards to how they want to experience The Wild Eight. Starting from 0.10, you won’t have to choose between “Single-player” and “Multiplayer” every time you start a server - now, you’ll be able to change between those modes right from the Pause menu! 

Had a fun time exploring Alaska on your own, and want your friends to join? That’s great! Got really far in a public game, and want to play alone, while keeping the character’s experience and items? No problem! 

[h1]Network Optimization
[/h1]

Last, but certainly not least! As we’ve mentioned in the posts above, at a certain point in development we realized that our network solution had to be re-designed - and it took a lot of work, but we did just that! 

No more of that pesky de-synchronization, no servers dropping for no apparent reason, and finally - 8 people can play the game on the same server without any netcode issues! (Hopefully.) So, we’re excited for you to give it a go and tell us your opinion! Please Note - there still may be some kinks to figure out with the new netcode, so please be patient - it will get perfected over time. 

[h1]Please Note [/h1]

Due to significant changes in the game’s architecture, the support for previous versions’ save files is now limited. Saves from 0.9 will be converted, and all of your progress will be brought over to the new version! Save files made on older versions (0.8 or below) will, unfortunately, not be available for use.

[quote] All of this, along with multiple bug fixes and balance changes, will be available on December 19th, 6 PM GMT / 12 PM CST / 1 PM EST - when the 0.10 Update becomes available! [/quote]


P.S. You can try out a Beta version of the 0.10 Update right now! See [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/526160/announcements/detail/3487373485837174475]this post[/url] for more details on how to join the Early Survivors, and try out the new features for yourself!

notes.title: Development Blog: Upcoming changes
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26293681/5debc6291119b9dd7c9f352b9650e29e929a4693.png[/img]

Hey survivors!

Today we would like to take a moment to share some details on what the development team is working on right now and what will happen with The Wild Eight this Fall.

We’re currently preparing a very important update for The Wild Eight. This very update was the reason why we kept silent for the last couple of months. Our goal is to improve the player experience and bring lots of new features to the game in the future.

[h1]Network improvements[/h1]

Lately we’ve been revamping our network system to provide smooth and stable performance. We completely changed the structure of the multiplayer by introducing a new, more streamlined networking system. For the sole purpose of bringing you the best multiplayer experience we’ve created a whole new network architecture. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26293681/71d9f466b3d56a9696106272182f21d6af1d2dd5.png[/img]

The host machine will now give permissions to the client machines and manage the synchronization. Previously the world logic was running on both host and client PCs. This caused lots of issues including actions leading to different results on client PCs. The new approach will also help reduce server load and in general has proven itself to be way more stable.

Moreover, our new system will allow players to switch back and forth between singleplayer and multiplayer anytime. So The Wild Eight will have fully functioning Drop-In-Drop-Out Multiplayer. Therefore, you can invite your friends to the game you started solo or just continue playing on your own using the same session you had with your friends. 

[h1]UI rework and controller support[/h1]

You asked, we listened - UI will also be receiving a major visual update! We’ll be adding a mini-map that should help you navigate the world more easily. We also didn’t forget about the general map - it also receives some visual and mechanical improvements. Other UI elements will get enhancements here and there as well for a better experience.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26293681/fa8fbb4138e710af3f08a03f26e5854f8eec09e9.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26293681/1a201319b5ddbdddb53b48658b0b46d8ad682196.jpg[/img]

Moreover, we’re not only working on the visual improvements, but also adding the long-awaited  full controller support. And we must say that The Wild Eight feels just right when played with a gamepad.

[h1]New content[/h1]

We’re also very excited to introduce all the new content we’ve been preparing. The content update is coming in a bit after the performance one.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26293681/820950a117fc257193df342f97619157e19d5140.jpg[/img]

Get ready for a new adventure with a new Quest we worked on lately. The Quest takes place in the new location - Alaska Visitor Center. Are there any survivors hiding inside? Why does this place feel so gloomy? Discover the secrets of this mysterious place.
 
Of course, lots of other additions are on it’s way so we guarantee that you’ll have fun exploring everything we worked on. 

[h1]Recent update summary[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26293681/f05a287056a41e7e31ac185bf3b1a28063f6129c.jpg[/img]

In the previous several updates we’ve added quite a bit of new stuff to the game. For those who missed out on the game during the summer we will give a brief overview. We’ve added a player revival for the multiplayer mode, blueprint system and snow piles. Of course, we didn’t forget to add new content like new weapons, items, side quests. Besides that we fixed lots and lots of bugs and introduced a new improved pathfinding system.

We hope you’re as excited about the upcoming changes as we’re! Stay tuned for more updates, we’ll make sure to come back with some content to show soon.

0.9.25 contains a renewed navigation pathfinding system, which ensures a smoother in-game animal movement. [img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26293681/a4e97ab757c399e0afc6d37dd3341ca97b6ec650.jpg[/img]

Hi!

Today we want to share some details on what the development team is working right now and what will happen with The Wild Eight in the nearest future.

In January we decided to take the plunge and rework the netcode from the ground up. It takes almost all of time of our engineers and they need around a month to implement it into the game.

Does the game really need it? Absolutely! It will fix most connection and desync problems we’re having, and will also let us add new game mechanics and content way easier.

Why wasn’t it done right from the beginning? There are a number of reasons: for original developers it was a first big game project and weak points were unavoidable. Also requirements to the system have been changing during the development, which also led to the increasing complexity of the architecture. Now, with a more experienced team and stable core mechanics, there is no doubt that new netcode is what the game needs.

We will keep you informed about all progress that’s been made. It will take some time, however - and we implore you to be patient. Thanks!

notes.notes:

Greetings from The Wild Eight Development Team! Below are the patch notes for version 0.8.52

[h1]Additions: [/h1]
[olist]
[*]Foxes are now added to the world of The Wild Eight. Hunt a Fox for a chance to get its tail, which can be used to craft a Fox Hat. 
[*]Other players, represented by icons, can now be seen on the Map. 
[*]Added the ability to invite other players into the game from lobby. 
[/olist]

[h1]Changes:[/h1]
[olist]
[*]“Dark Matter” side-quest reworked. 
[*]Lowered health and hunger meter regeneration rates on several food items. 
[*]Fixed an issue, where instead of equipping all Throwing Stones in a single stack, player would only equip one.
[*]You can now activate Hydra-1 Radio Tower with a single click, instead of two - if you’ve acquired both a Generator and a Key Card. 
[/olist]

[h1]Fixes: [/h1]
[olist]
[*]Changes to networking, which caused de-synchronization between players
[*]Fixed an issue with some of the quest-related items not displaying properly.
[*]Fixed an issue where “Garden Salad”  healed 15 health points a second instead of intended 1.5 points. 
[*]Fixed an issue where the player would receive additional damage after dying from a fall, and therefore dying again after respawn. 
[*]Fixed an issue where a non-equipped weapon remained in player’s inventory after his death.
[*]Fixed an issue in “Home, Sweet Home” side-quest, where a key-card dropped by a mutant could get stuck in the wall. 
[*]If the furnace is extinguished during the smelting process, the player now receives the intended 60 Ore instead of 1.  
[*]Ammo picked up from the ground is now automatically equipped.
[*]Changed stamina rates for the Power Attack. 
[*]Removed the ability to fix the broken bridge after finishing the main quest line. 
[*]Changes to the Blizzard event - now it spawns no more than once a day. 
[*]Fixed an issue where the player was not able to pick the Sledge back up after removing it from his inventory. 
[*]Fixed an issue where a player would re-acquire all of the Decipher Keys for “The Door” quest after restarting the game.
[/olist]

Happy Christmas Greetings, Survivors! 
(Or Hanukkah, Kwanzaa - whatever suits you)

The holidays are right around the corner - and what better way to celebrate them than surviving the cold and desolate wilds of Alaska alongside your friends and family? This Holiday season we’ve decided to give back to our fans - so every player can find a special present next time they launch the game. Perfect for spreading that Holiday cheer! 

Alongside new Holiday content, we’ve also updated the game and fixed some of the current issues. See the full patch notes below:

[olist]
[*]Added a new item - Flashlight. Combine “Broken Flashlight” and “Batteries” in your workshop to use it 
[*]Weapon equipment slots are now displayed on the HUD 
[*]The player now respawns in the Bunker Hub (if it is unlocked and not exploded).[/olist]

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[olist]
[*]Fixed an issue where equipping a full stack of Throwing Stones while both equipment slots and the inventory are full resulted in the weapon replaced by Throwing Stones disappearing

notes.title: The Wild Eight 0.8 is here!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26293681/70b2c80a92aa6bbbbd03a22e714bc891fd90c98b.gif[/img]

With the new and improved Battle System, the combat is now more responsive and fluid than ever before! 

You’re able to charge your attack to do massive damage to whatever stands in your way! Moving freely while charging your Power Attack allows for a more tactical approach to hunting. 
You can now throw any equipped weapon - which is really useful for dealing damage to your opponents from a distance. Furthermore, you can now lock onto enemies during combat, which improves your general aim. 

We’ve also added a few improvements to the way you use throws - for example, RMB no longer acts as a dedicated throwing button. You still can throw items out of your inventory with the T button, so you’ll be able to share resources (or hit your friend in the face with some human meat) any time you want. 

Along with an updated Battle System, 0.8 features minor quality-of-life improvements and general bug fixes.  The full list can be seen below: 

[h1]New Features: [/h1]
[olist][*]Added Power Attack 
[*]Added the ability to throw equipped weapon 
[*]Added Lock-on
[*]Players are now able to fully rebind keyboard controls 
[*]Picked up weapons are now automatically equipped into an empty slot 
[/olist]

[h1]Changes: [/h1]
[olist][*]Throwing Stones now work differently - they act as an equippable item and can now be used in melee combat as well 
[*]Changed the way player throws items out of inventory - which is now done with the T button 
[*]Flare gun radius increased - it now opens twice as many tiles on the map
[*]A tamed animal no longer gets hungrier while the player’s off the main map (in a bunker/cavern/other special location)
[/olist]

[h1]Fixes:[/h1] 
[olist][*]Fixed a resource gathering issue that caused Vivian to gather less resources
[*]Fixed a bug where quest items would reappear after a player has re-joined the server 
[*]Fixed a bug that allowed players to use regeneration seats without opening the Rec Room door 
[*]Fixed a bug which caused items to float in air after a player’s death 
[*]Fixed a bug which caused an in-game item to not disappear from the map on pick up 
[/olist]

We hope you enjoy checking out the new update, while we continue working on The Wild Eight and enhancing the player experience. Check back for more details real soon! 

If you played The Wild Eight enough to know if you would recommend it, we'd love for you to leave a quick review. Cheers!

The Wild Eight development team is hard at work on improving the game experience, as well as adding new features and slowly, but surely bringing the game closer to its final state. Like the game? Have any feedback on ways how to improve our game? Be sure to [url=http://store.steampowered.com/recommended/recommendgame/526160]leave a quick review[/url], which will greatly help us make a better game. Cheers!

notes.title: Battle Update Is Coming December 11
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26293681/bc9aa895bbbfd46f8fb734961abc1b51a4ebe994.jpg[/img]

Hey there, Survivors! We’ve got a few surprises to hold you over on these cold and wintry nights - some fresh, red-hot details about the Battle Update, coming to The Wild Eight on [b]December 11[/b]! 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26293681/f6f3867e920bb1109b3ece86ee2a59559ad509ae.gif[/img]

Tired of chasing down animals, only to hit them once as you watch them run away? Killing boars with sticks and stones is too boring and takes too much time? No more! 

In The Wild Eight 0.8, you’ll be able to [b]charge your attack to do massive damage[/b] to whatever (or whoever) stands in your way! This type of attack depletes a part of your stamina, though - so be careful not to miss too much, or you’ll be too winded to pursue your target. 

You’ll also be able to [b]move freely while charging your Power Attack[/b], which allows for a more tactical approach for hunting - sneaking up on animals with your attack fully charged is just one of the ways you can use this new move to your advantage. 

Be aware that Charge Attack won’t work without a weapon - how would you even charge your fists, anyway? 

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/xUOxeQeHBis2APQJ32/giphy.gif[/img]

The frozen wilds of Alaska seldom often brief respite - but our players again and again found ways to entertain themselves along the way. Throwing items into enemies, as well as fellow players, was just one of them - and we liked that concept so much, we decided to expand on it. 

Now, you’re able to [b]throw any weapon you have equipped[/b] - which is really useful for dealing damage to your opponents from a distance. That deer won’t run away from you now! 

We’ve also added a few improvements to the way you use throws - for example, RMB no longer acts as a dedicated throwing button. The reason for it - one of the issues we’ve seen throughout countless letsplays and streams of The Wild Eight is that players would throw something out of their inventory on accident.

You still can throw items out of your inventory with the T button, so you’ll be able to share resources (or hit your friend in the face with some human meat) any time you want. 

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/xUOxeQU3mGUFqUNThe/giphy.gif[/img]

As a part of us preparing for finally enabling full Controller Support for the game (which is coming sooner rather than later), we’ve added an ability to lock onto your opponents during combat. 

If you’re locked onto your enemy, your character will continue to face him - this way, hitting enemies from a distance will now be a bit easier. Time your throws wisely - animals are constantly on the move, so Lock On won’t guarantee a successful hit. 

Also, throwing and shooting from higher ground works much better with lock-on, so be sure to use it when you want to attack someone from a distance while standing on a steep hill. 

The 0.8 Update will come out this Monday, but you already can start preparing for it - with the new control layout, which can be seen below: 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26293681/a33b0e1f7c12e89b53f47e1c452749640d914f6a.jpg[/img]

There’s one more point we have to address - yes, we're absolutely aware that the update is coming a bit behind schedule - and we'll be sure to address this in the next post, which will be right after 0.8's release.

Thank you for patience and good luck in severe lands of Alaska!

notes.notes:
Lovers of uncooked mushrooms may remember The Wild Eight, an extra-tough multiplayer survival game set in a frozen wasteland following a plane crash. I thought it wasn t bad, even if your hunger bar drained faster than a broken bathtub. Since its release however, there seems to have been a split among its creators. In the meantime, the original developers, Fntastic, are off to make a new game, called Dead Dozen.

It s set in a frozen wasteland. (more…)

Patch 0.6 is now available to download! The key changes in this update affect character progression and player’s interaction with the environment. 

Now the player character requires less EXP to gain a new level - so skill points are earned faster. This affects all skill trees, especially “Gathering” and ‘Defense”. 

The amount of resources required for structure upgrades has also been subject to re-balancing and now correlates to player’s ability to stack up more wood and stone in his inventory.

Seeds and generators have now been moved from regular items to quest items - which means they can’t be lost for good in pits anymore. In addition to that, they are no longer require free space in inventory and can easily be accessed by all players on the server. Putting generators and seeds into quest items has eliminated the need for drag and drop - all you need to do is click on the object you wish to interact with.

We’ve also increased the gun’s damage output and made it so the player can pick up unused traps from the ground back into his inventory. 

Full list of changes and fixes: 

[b]Changes:[/b]
[olist]
[*]Lowered amount of experience points required for gaining a new level
[*]Lowered amount of resources needed for upgrading structures
[*]Generators and seeds are now a quest item
[*]Generators and seeds are now used automatically, no drag-and-drop required 
[*]Increased Gun’s damage output 
[*]Player is now able to pick up unused traps from the ground 
[/olist]
[b]Fixes:[/b]
[olist]
[*]Fixed a bug where a player character falls through textures in “The Door” quest.
[*]Depleted ore deposits now give the player additional resources;
[*]Fixed a bug where a player couldn’t pick up “enhanced steel axe” from the ground;
[*]Fixed a bug that resulted in player’s items hanging up in the air at the respawn point;
[*]Fixed a bug that caused player’s structures to become unavailable for upgrade or packing up;
[*]Fixed version recognition bug that caused joined players positions to be rolled back to the plane crash after loading an MP game.
[/olist]

notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26293681/53efe8476fb5d9bdea50074c66f4b679f70359c1.jpg[/img]

The Wild Eight is now 0.4.1. We're still working on fixing all of the issues you've been posting to us on Steam discussions, so expect another patches to appear soon.

Here's the patch note with all the fixes and improvements.

[h1] Key Changes: [/h1]
[olist]
[*]Now in the game settings you can configure the FPS lock. It can be useful for those players who reported on the overheating of the video card. Also, it's worth considering that the activated V-Sync locks the FPS at 60
[*]Easy and Classic game difficulty are renamed to Explorer and Survivor. In Single player mode, “Explorer” is now the default difficulty level. In multiplayer, the default difficulty is now “Survivor”
[/olist]
[h1] Improvements: [/h1]
[olist]
[*]Training - Added a part about learning Sprint and a hint about how to use it
[*]HUB - Now you can stabilize HUB at any time, not only on the 32nd day
[*]HUB - Added a siren inside the HUB and an in-game notification on the 32nd day without stabilization, and another in-chat notification when the HUB is destroyed
[*]Traps - Now if players or animals are trapped, they get immunity to the next trap for 2 seconds
[*]Traps - Reduced speed reduction when hit by an Iron Trap or Spiked Trap (compensated by slowdown from Bleeding)
[*]Yeti - Now he regenerates 2% of health per second when there are no players nearby
[*]Yeti - Now, when Yeti screams, the stones will fall more often on the players' heads
[*]Craft - Now, when crafting items, the free space that appears in the inventory after the next crafting will be taken into account

[olist]
[*]Fixed the disappearance of resources when dragging more than 80 units of resources into the inventory of a player who doesn’t have the ability to carry an increased number of resources

notes.title: First big content update - "Beyond The Door"
notes.notes:

[h1]Welcome the first big content update for The Wild Eight - Beyond The Door! [/h1]
 
Finally, after a long wait, something even bigger awaits both experienced survivors and newcomers alike in the harsh lands of Alaska: we're proud to announce that the first big content update for The Wild Eight - “Beyond The Door” is here.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fpinGH7NJcY 

Here are some of the main features that the survivors have to look forward to in the new update:
 
 
[olist]
[*][b]New Quests:[/b] team up with other survivors to uncover even more secrets of Vapor-3 research project.
    [*][b]Expanded In-game World:[/b] a huge abandoned scientific bunker awaiting somewhere within the frozen landscape, that have all the options to become your new home. One of its key features is a full-scale greenhouse farm, where you can grow up crops with further possibility to cook them into something edible.
    [*][b]Fast travel system: [/b]uncover hidden railway stations that will allow you to instantly jump between them
   [*][b]Dangerous Bosses:[/b] a furious beast got unleashed on the world of The Wild Eight - track him down and defeat him for big rewards.
[*][b]Added new skills and abilities:[/b] enhanced and updated character development system.
[*][b]General bug fixes and rebalance:[/b] smooth gameplay will become even more enjoyable.
[*][b]And of course new items on locations.[/b]
[/olist]


[h1]Full Update Notes:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added “The Door” side quest -  it will shed light on some parts of the plot an
d the reward for completion will be one of the most useful items in game.
[*]Added “Home, Sweet Home” side quest  -gain access to a fully operational bunker with a lot of useful functions. Inside you’ll be able to grow crops and prepare dishes from them, increase your skill points by using gym equipment and fast travel between main in-game locations using the underground railroad system.
[*]Added a new fearsome enemy (Raid Boss)  -  There is a new cave on map that will lead you to an unknown ferocious creature. It will take all your efforts to take him down, but the reward is well worth it.
[*]Added 7 new equipment items, which can be found in the game world
[*]Added another skill level for a total of 6
[*]Added a new workshop level, and 8 new craftable items
[*]Optimised the skill system - added new skills and rebalanced the previous ones, mainly the “Hunting” skill tree
[*]Arrows can be equipped in your inventory window now.
[*]Game is now playable in windowed mode.
[*]Rebalanced the amount of items on all the tiles.
[*]Rebalanced animal population in the game.
[*]Rebalanced item drops from animals.
[*]Improved Animal AI
[*]UI changes for a better and more optimised experience

[b]Please notice:[/b] this update does not support savings from older versions of the game since it adds new tiles and objects to the game world.

Thanks for your patience and good luck in the frozen lands of Alaska!

[*]Steam Invites added
[*]Chat command "/unstuck" added[/olist]

[*]Reduced possibility of falling to death in the location where there is a trap with a bone that was leading to the cave (teleport will happen earlier than before)

notes.title: Release Date, Price and More
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26293681/6f29a5d44048dd8d58fbb85e70ade4cba1f66e2c.png[/img]

Hi Survivors, Ivan from HypeTrain is here.

Thanks for your waiting, questions and ideas. We read, discuss inside the team and take all of them into consideration.

You will be able to begin your journey in The Wild Eight very soon. To be more specific: circle [b]February 8[/b] in your calendar. The Wild Eight will be launching on Steam Early Access for [b]$19.99 USD[/b].

This winter has become a time to rethink. The upgrade system you could have tried in Pre-Alpha Demo was completely redesigned as well as the technical side of the multiplayer. Changes affected ourselves too, but first things first.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/26gso5sH8RVrXfE3e/source.gif[/img]

New unscheduled features significantly improve The Wild Eight and we are finally ready to give you an opportunity to buy and play the game. We’ve decided to release in Early Access since the development continues with a big world expansion in mind. Along with tuning the game balance and fixing minor bugs it will take mere 3 months.

Multiplayer mode will work from the day one and the game will have long hours of adventures. Don't forget that The Wild Eight – unlike most of other games we all see on Steam today – is both challenging survival sandbox and a story-driven experience with quests. I really hope you’ll love it as much as we do.

What is going to be added as a part of the Early Access updates:
[olist]
[*] Game balance and bug fixes based on your feedback
[*] New side-quests and objects
[*] A more advanced combat system including shooting
[*] Better user interface and map
[*] New languages
[*] Mac and Linux Support
[/olist]

Updates will be coming every two weeks. Also Early Access players will get some special cosmetic reward.
 
On another note, developers of The Wild Eight are proud to present their new name – Fntastic! During the whole development process the team has grown up – both in experience and amount of people (and previous name Eight Points was mainly about the first eight developers who started it all). To express gratitude to the ones who worked on The Wild Eight but left the team we would like to keep Eight Points as the second developer. 

[quote]
One and a half years ago it was even hard to imagine the possibility of developing a game here in Yakutia that will attract so much attention all over the world. It's already a big success for us and we want to thank everyone who believed in us during the  Kickstarter campaign and everyone who is awaiting the release. 

Our new name Fntastic stands for breaking the boundaries and art of imagination. They are our main tools in making The Wild Eight you'll enjoy.[/quote]

– Ed Gotovtsev, CEO [url=http://www.fntastic.com/]Fntastic[/url]

notes.title: Why we are not announcing an exact release date
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26293681/76618f835e943881071fb5568baaccd8acf3337e.jpg[/img]

Hello survivors!

Thanks for your interest and eagerness to play The Wild Eight.

Recently after internal playtests our team decided to fully rethink in-game upgrade system. According to our estimates – along with other game improvements – it will take from a month to two of the development and bugfixes. We believe that it’s wrong to promise any exact day release until all the uncertainty will go away. Keeping you updated and sharing all the news is the right thing to do though. All in all, the game is quite close to the release.

This week we made one more highly important decision we want to share. But first take a deeeep breath :)

The Wild Eight is coming out as a full release on Steam (yes, no Early Access). The main reason for it is to show our devotion to the project and the community, as well as to convince you that the game will be fully playable and enjoyable right after the release. However, it does not a bit negate that we will continue the development after pressing the release button – expect regular updates with more items, story, and modes. 

But it’s in the future. Our only goal in present is to make a great game you’ll love.

* Cold in the daytime decreased by ~25%

* Cold beyond the borders of the map increased by 30%
* Campfire lifetime increased from 100 to 120 sec.
* Campfire lifetime in the blizzard increased from 9 to 12 sec.
* Heat from the torch decreased by 40%
* Torch durability decreased form 100 to 90

[b]Design:[/b]
* Fading campfire won't stop providing light before extinction
* Fading torch won't stop providing light before extinction
* Some sounds have been changed

[b]The Wild Eight Steam page is live! Everyone can now add it to their wishlist and subscribe for updates :) [/b]

[h1] Alpha-Access [/h1]

All our backers who purchased Alpha-access have received their keys. Check your mailbox if you are one. Feel free to record videos, take screenshots and share them on social networks and to your friends!

What’s new:
[list]
[*] Multiplayer up to 8 players 
[*] Updated survival system 
[*] Game balance improvements 
[*] New locations including storages and radio stations 
[*] Graphical improvements 
[*] Global code optimization 
[*] Updated animation of William and animals 
[*] Updated animals AI 
[*] YEAH, BEARS!!!
[/list]

Please remember, that it’s not the final version of the game, so lots of work still needs to be done including features we announced on Kickstarter and tuning of every game element. The Wild Eight is going to be updated at least two times in a month with lots of new content every time.

Beta and Early Access is coming next month with all eight characters, side quests and other stuff!

[h1] Early Access?! [/h1]

Yes, dudes. We decided to make The Wild Eight available for everyone in Early Access. It’s a great way to continue the development with more feedback from the community.

Full release is coming at the end of year. More accurate dates soon :)
